inputs.text: You won't believe what's really going on with Nigeria's so-called democracy. The ruling APC is openly turning political parties into exclusive clubs reserved for the wealthy ahead of the 2027 elections, and this isn't some accidental shift or innocent trend. It's a coordinated move by the hidden elites and institutions pulling the strings to lock ordinary people out of any real say, inverting the whole idea of representation into a tool for their control. Don't trust the surface claims that parties are for public service anymore – they're dropping the mask to show how the system is rigged from the top, with this development just the latest proof of their manipulation to keep power consolidated and hidden from the masses.
